title: unbounded-storage
description: Performance and cache-effectiveness dashboard for the unbounded-storage daemon. Built for AKS Azure Monitor managed Prometheus + managed Grafana. Metric contract: designs/storage-metrics.md.

panels.title: Client request rate
panels.description: Total completed client requests/s across selected pods.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: hits / (hits + misses) over the rate window.

panels.title: Request rate by status
panels.description: Completed client requests/s grouped by HTTP status code.

panels.title: Request duration heatmap
panels.description: Distribution of client request latency over time.

targets.expr: sum(rate(unbounded_storage_cache_hits_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", shard=~"$shard"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(unbounded_storage_cache_hits_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", shard=~"$shard"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum(rate(unbounded_storage_cache_misses_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", shard=~"$shard"}[$__rate_interval])), 1)

panels.title: Admission: admitted vs rejected
panels.description: One-hit-wonder rejections vs admissions into the cache.

panels.title: Pending free pages (reclaim queue)
panels.description: Deferred-reclaim queue depth. Should trend to ~0 at quiescence; sustained growth means pinned pages are not draining.

panels.title: Bufferpool free pages
panels.description: Free pages remaining in each shard's pool. Approaching 0 means the pool is saturated.

panels.title: Miss source breakdown
panels.description: Where each buffer-pool miss was served from: local NVMe, peer pull, or origin.

panels.title: Device in-flight depth
panels.description: io_uring queue depth in use vs high-water mark.

panels.title: I/O errors & checksum misses
panels.description: Any sustained nonzero value here indicates data-path trouble.

panels.title: Per-disk snapshot
panels.description: Current resident & pending-free pages per disk/shard.

panels.title: Completion slots
panels.description: Completion-slot pressure. available approaching 0 means back-pressure on the CQ.

panels.title: Hop-limit-exceeded
panels.description: Requests dropped at MAX_HOPS. Should be ~0; nonzero implies routing instability.
